name: Eastern gray squirrel
introduction: A familiar neighbor. A voice worth knowing.

sounds.title: A squirrel calling
sounds.description: A lone gray squirrel, recorded in Camberley, England in 1977. Listen for the rhythm of its calls and the sounds around it.
